audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart rows 5 (First item) and 6 (2+ items) said Urgot/Skill in both layers, but the whys already said Tryndamere wins those stages, the packet levelChart lists Tryndamere for both, and the mirror audit flipped them to Tryndamere.
audit.why: Urgot leads levels 2-6 at 53.26% over 905 games, but Tryndamere's first crit item plus Fury and the 5s of Undying Rage take the late 1v1.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side/win[5] and phases[6].side/win[6] flipped to Tryndamere with ratings lowered to 4/10 and 3/10, and the matching whys rewritten.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Urgot spikes at 3-5 with the full Echoing Flames rotation and at Black Cleaver; Tryndamere spikes at 6 with Undying Rage and again at his first crit item.
audit.corrected: Left spikes[0..3] alone; only the first-item stage of the level chart moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was titled 'Anti-heal his crit healing' but its body text was a duplicate of the Undying Rage trade line — the anti-heal interaction was never actually stated. dontsFull[1].d gave no cooldown number.
audit.why: Bloodlust (Q) is Tryndamere's only sustain, consuming Fury to heal; the missing-interactions file flags Grievous Wounds timing as the deciding factor in extended trades. Fear Beyond Death is a 100/85/70s cooldown, so spending it into Undying Rage costs the whole window.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names Bloodlust and Executioner's Calling on the first back; dontsFull[1].d now carries the 100s rank-1 cooldown against his 5s.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Tryndamere to trade into the spike.
edits.after: His first crit item and stacked Fury swing auto-and-Spin trades to him — shove for plates and refuse head-on melee once Bloodlust is up.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Tryndamere must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: He cannot die for 5s through Undying Rage and he splitpushes better than you 1v1 — group, take objectives, and let him shove into your team's numbers.

edits.before: Tryndamere wastes Undying Rage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bloodlust is his only sustain — Executioner's Calling on the first back halves it.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death is down 100s at rank 1 — wait out his 5s, then execute.

notes: Undying Rage's 5-second duration is not in Riot's kit text; it was already asserted throughout the existing entry (breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1]) so I kept it consistent rather than introducing it. Riot's own description ('unable to die, no matter how wounded') supports the 'cannot die' phrasing I used in phases[6].why. The mirror's flagged claim that Urgot's R 'survives it' is still unverified and I did not add any new instance of it.
